name: dynamic-endpoint
description:
Routes requests to an upstream chosen at request time: a fixed target named by targetUpstream (one of the API's upstream definitions or, failing that, a gateway-wide Backend), the gateway-wide Backend a CEL expression names from the request context (headers, path, metadata, API, route or authenticated claims), or a host built per request through a templated Backend whose endpoint host takes a key (backendKeyExpression).
Backends are added and changed on the gateway without editing or redeploying the APIs that route to them; a Backend that an API names in targetUpstream, without an upstream definition of that name, is removed after that API stops naming it.
